starterCode:
# There be 演示台
scene = 1   # 1单数 2复数 3不可数

hide()
t = "单数名词用 There is"
s = "There is a book on the desk."
tip = "a/an + 单数名词，动词用 is"
if scene == 2:
    t = "复数名词用 There are"
    s = "There are two birds in the tree."
    tip = "two/some + 复数名词，动词用 are"
if scene == 3:
    t = "不可数名词也用 There is"
    s = "There is some water in the glass."
    tip = "water/milk/bread 不可数，动词用 is"
fill_rect(0, 130, 340, 30, "#16a34a")
write(t, 0, 130, "#fff", 13)
fill_rect(0, 60, 320, 64, "#f0fdf4")
write(s, 0, 60, "#166534", 12)
fill_rect(0, -20, 320, 50, "#fef3c7")
write(tip, 0, -20, "#b45309", 11)
write("There be 表存在 · have 表拥有", 0, -78, "#64748b", 10)
title: There be 句型：某处有某物
story: There is a book on the desk.——「桌上有本书」就这么说！There be 是英语里的「有」字句：某处存在某物用它，某人拥有用 have。is 还是 are？看后面的名词是单数还是复数！

sections.title: 基本结构
sections.body:
【There be + 某物 + 某处 = 某处有某物】
There is a cat under the tree.（树上有只猫）
There are some apples on the table.
be 动词看后面的名词：单数/不可数→is·复数→are。

sections.title: 就近原则
sections.body:
【多个名词并列时，be 与最近的名词一致】
There is a pen and two books on the desk.（最近的是 a pen → is）
There are two books and a pen on the desk.（最近的是 two books → are）
口诀：be 看邻居，就近不商量。

sections.title: some/any 与否定疑问
sections.body:
【肯定句用 some】There are some ducks on the lake.
【否定/疑问句用 any】There are not any ducks. / Are there any ducks?
【一般疑问回答】Yes, there is. / No, there are not.
There be 表存在；I have 表拥有——两码事。

examples.q: 翻译：书包里有两支铅笔。
steps: There are + 数量 + 复数
There are two pencils in the bag

examples.q: There ___ a dog and two cats here. 填？
steps: 最近的是 a dog 单数

mistakes: 见 There 就用 is（复数要用 are）
疑问句还用 some（应用 any）
